title: Hearty Korean Rice Fried Rice
description: A sour, tender, and indulgent Korean dish featuring rice, fry, and nut-free friendly ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is a delicious and easy way to use up leftover rice and vegetables.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet or wok, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir in the soy sauce, gochujang, and kimchi, cooking for about 2-3 minutes, until the rice is well coated.
Add the chopped green onion, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the rice is heated through and starting to brown.
Remove the skillet or wok from the heat and serve the fried rice hot.
Garnish with additional green onion and kimchi, if desired.
